title: Shelby Cobra vs AC Ace: The Real Difference
description:
One car is a graceful British roadster with a six-cylinder engine and a top speed of about a hundred sixteen miles per hour. The other is the same body with a Ford V eight and a top speed of a hundred sixty-four. One was sold in the hundreds. The other is among the most famous American cars ever made. This is the real difference between the Shelby Cobra and the A C Ace. Here is the twist. The Cobra is an Ace. The chassis, the body and the factory are the same, and the Cobra's low nose was developed for an Ace. Yet in the sales we can find, the two cars sell in completely different price bands, by a factor of about ten. Let us go through the numbers, and the places where the sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
